SELECT r.logistics_product_id AS productId, r.bill_month AS billMonth, r.currency AS currency, COUNT(*) AS usageCount, COALESCE(SUM(r.amount), 0) AS subtotal FROM wms_client_billing_record r
GROUP BY r.logistics_product_id, r.bill_month, r.currency ORDER BY r.bill_month DESC, subtotal DESC
